# Expert mixing

How a remote-expert pool combines its members at inference. Named by the chosen orchestration profile, not by a flag of its own.

Registry: ``praxis.MIXING_REGISTRY`` (6 entries)

## `mean`

Pool average (consensus / pure bias). Robust, deterministic.

## `sample`

Keep a random half of experts then average - stochastic.

## `sample_quarter`

Keep a random quarter then average - higher variance.

## `vote`

Average the per-expert distributions (CALM expert vote).

## `wave`

Standing wave over the expert index - peers compose by interference.

## `wave_high`

Standing wave, doubled frequency over the peer axis.
